dgxNote: In *MiraVerse v1.6*, *Qatar (QA: The Pearl of Stories)* is presented as a culturally rich, narrative-dense region where oral traditions and historical memory are encoded into architectural motifs and communal rituals—though its epistemic coherence remains contested due to fragmented source-layering between pre-oil folklore and modern state branding.

country.settingSummaryEn: A thoughtfully researched historic Doha coastal harbor district and Al Zubarah-inspired heritage/trade-learning courtyard, carefully distinguishing UNESCO-listed archaeological sites from our invented quest workshops.
country.settingSummaryAr: حي ساحلي تاريخي مستوحى من مرفأ الدوحة القديم وساحة تعليمية مستلهمة من الزبارة، مع التمييز الواضح بين المواقع الأثرية الحقيقية وورش المغامرة التخيلية.
country.settingSummaryArabizi: Hayy sahili tarikhi مستوحى min marfa il-Doha il-qadim wa sahat ta3lim مستلهمة min Al-Zubarah.
country.folkloreAndEpistemicFrameEn: Folklore Note: The tale of Al Fisaikra is presented explicitly as Qatari and Gulf coastal folklore (pending corroboration of regional oral variants)—never as literal historical fact. Pearl diving history is taught through safe harbor craftsmanship, rope-making, and pearl-sorting weights without perilous underwater breath-holding reenactments.
country.folkloreAndEpistemicFrameAr: ملاحظة معرفية: تُقدَّم حكاية «الفسيفكرة» بوصفها حكاية شعبية ساحلية قطرية وخليجية (قيد توثيق الروايات الشفهية المتعددة) وليست حدثاً تاريخياً حرفياً.
country.folkloreAndEpistemicFrameArabizi: Mulahaza: Hikayat Al-Fisaikra hiya turath sha3bi sahili (folklore) wa laysat tarikh harfi.
country.diasporaNarrativeEn: For Qatari and Gulf families living abroad, the harbor return song of Al Qaffal, woven palm-leaf baskets, and shared cardamom-saffron sweets keep coastal memory alive across oceans.
country.diasporaNarrativeAr: لعائلات قطر والخليج في المهجر، تظل أهازيج «القفال» وسلال الخوص المنسوجة والقهوة والحلويات العطرية جسراً دافئاً يربط الأبناء بذاكرة الساحل.
country.diasporaNarrativeArabizi: Li-3ailat Qatar fil-mahjar, ihtifal Al-Qaffal wa silal il-khous yirbut il-ajyal bi-dhakirat il-bahr.

glossary.englishGloss: Natural sea pearls (traditionally called qimash in Gulf pearl trade)
glossary.culturalNote: In historic Qatari and Gulf usage, natural pearls were affectionately termed qimash alongside lulu.

glossary.englishGloss: Traditional flat-transom wooden dhow with a vertical bow used along Qatar's coast
glossary.culturalNote: Built and maintained by master shipwrights (qallaf) along Doha Bay.
Uses palm-fiber rope, wooden mallets, and shark-liver/plant oils to seal hull planks.

glossary.englishGloss: Pearl merchant who grades pearls by size, luster, and weight
glossary.culturalNote: Uses brass sieves (tasa) and mithqal scales in fair harbor exchange.

glossary.englishGloss: Qatari coastal folktale of a kind young woman aided by a magical sea fish (Folklore)
glossary.culturalNote: Explicitly classified as folklore pending regional variant corroboration.

glossary.englishGloss: The joyous coastal homecoming marking the safe return of pearl boats to shore
glossary.culturalNote: Celebrates family reunion, gratitude, and shoreline welcome signals.

questActs.settingSubarea: Historic Doha Dhow Yard & Harbor Pier
questActs.summaryEn: Explore the harbor workshop, identify jalboot dhow components, woven date-palm rope, and safe deck tools while learning maritime safety and history.
questActs.summaryAr: استكشف ورشة المرفأ وتعرّف على أجزاء سفينة الجالبوت وحبال ليف النخيل وأدوات السطح الآمنة وتاريخ البحر.
questActs.summaryArabizi: Yalla niktishif warshat il-marfa, ajza safinat il-jalboot, wa hbal leef il-nakhil bi-aman.
questActs.epistemicWarningEn: Teaches maritime history and deck safety from shore; never simulates dangerous breath-hold diving.

objectiveGraph.descriptionEn: Greet Ustadha Noora at the Doha boatwright pier and inspect the Qallaf Timber Ledger.
objectiveGraph.hintEn: Look for the lantern-lit workbench beside the dry-docked jalboot hull.
objectiveGraph.failureRecovery: Ledger remains pinned on the workbench; Ustadha Noora repeats the visual icon clue.

objectiveGraph.descriptionEn: Gather 3 safe harbor components: teak rib plank, braided date-palm rope (khabt), and woven dayyin deck basket.
objectiveGraph.hintEn: Follow the turquoise harbor pennants along the shaded carpentry shed.
objectiveGraph.failureRecovery: Items respawn immediately with no timer or penalty.

objectiveGraph.descriptionEn: Assemble the safe decorative dhow display stand and log the components in the ledger.
objectiveGraph.hintEn: Place the rib plank, rope coil, and basket onto the harbor museum pedestal.

coopBehavior.roleSplitEn: Player 1 inspects timber ribs while Player 2 traces date-palm rope cordage; both place items on the shared dhow display.

5-7.titleEn: Match the Boat Parts by the Sea
5-7.objectiveEn: Tap the picture icons to match the wooden hull plank, soft palm rope, and woven basket with Ustadha Noora!
5-7.objectiveAr: اضغط على الصور لمطابقة لوح الخشب وحبل النخيل والسلة المنسوجة مع الأستاذة نورة!
5-7.objectiveArabizi: Yalla niktishif il-khashab wal-habl wal-salla ma3 Ustadha Noora!

8-10.robloxAdapterMechanics: Tagged prop collection around Doha Harbor with bilingual UI card flip.
8-10.bedrockAdapterMechanics: Shapeless recipe assembly of decorative dhow display + bilingual ledger dialog.

11-13.titleEn: Investigating Indian Ocean Timber & Cordage Routes
11-13.titleAr: تحقيق مسارات أخشاب وحبال المحيط الهندي

11-13.scaffoldingAndHintEn: Map table shows trade wind arrows between the Gulf and Malabar coast.
11-13.robloxAdapterMechanics: Co-op two-station inventory verification and harbor safety inspection checklist.
11-13.bedrockAdapterMechanics: Multi-station chest inspection and decorative dhow blueprint placement.

14-17.titleEn: Source-Critical Archiving: Maritime Labor, Ecology & Museum Provenance
14-17.titleAr: التوثيق النقدي: العمل البحري والبيئة وتاريخ المقتنيات

14-17.objectiveEn: Analyze primary and museum provenance records from Al Zubarah (UNESCO #1402) and Doha harbor to curate an ethically framed exhibit on dhow craftsmanship and crew safety.
14-17.objectiveAr: حلل سجلات موقع الزبارة (اليونسكو #1402) ومرفأ الدوحة لإعداد معرض توثيقي أمين حول صناعة المحامل وسلامة البحارة.
14-17.objectiveArabizi: Hallil sijillat Al-Zubarah (UNESCO #1402) wa marfa il-Doha li-tasmin ma3rad tawthiqi.
14-17.puzzleMechanicsEn: Provenance verification challenge distinguishing corroborated archaeological evidence from unverified oral anecdotes.
14-17.scaffoldingAndHintEn: Provenance drawer provides direct citations to UNESCO #1402 and museum catalogs.
14-17.robloxAdapterMechanics: Curatorial terminal where players assign epistemic badges and resource trade ratios.
14-17.bedrockAdapterMechanics: Provenance lectern inspection + multi-stage harbor exhibit construction.

questActs.summaryEn: Practice fair exchange in an old merchant courtyard; distinguish natural pearls, brass sieves (tasa), and supplies without pretending modern currency prices are historical.

objectiveGraph.descriptionEn: Sort sample pearl replicas through the 3 brass tasa sieves by size (Dana, Hasbah, Bdla).

objectiveGraph.failureRecovery: Sieves gently re-sort with visual size rings.

objectiveGraph.descriptionEn: Complete a fair community barter exchanging harbor cordage and fresh water jars for winter dates and woven mats.
objectiveGraph.hintEn: Ensure both the boat crew and the oasis caravan merchant receive balanced supplies.
objectiveGraph.failureRecovery: Barter scale shows a friendly balance indicator.

coopBehavior.roleSplitEn: One player grades pearl sizes with the tasa sieves while the partner balances caravan supply baskets.

5-7.titleEn: Big Pearl, Little Pearl Sieve Game

8-10.titleEn: Fair Exchange at the Tawash Stall

8-10.objectiveArabizi: Ifriz il-lulu bil-tasa wa wazin muqayada 3adila min il-tamr wal-hibal.
8-10.puzzleMechanicsEn: 2-step sieve grading + fair barter scale puzzle.
8-10.scaffoldingAndHintEn: Scale needle points green when both families' needs are met.
8-10.robloxAdapterMechanics: Role-based negotiation UI with transparent supply equivalences.
8-10.bedrockAdapterMechanics: Custom non-monetary barter exchange with the merchant NPC.

11-13.objectiveEn: Investigate how Al Zubarah merchants used agate weights and brass sieves to connect Gulf pearl banks with regional caravan trade.
11-13.objectiveAr: ابحث في كيفية استخدام تجار الزبارة لأوزان العقيق والطاسات لربط مغاصات الخليج بتجارة القوافل.
11-13.objectiveArabizi: Ibhath fi kayfiyat istikhdam tujjar Al-Zubarah li-awzan il-3aqiq wal-tasat.
11-13.puzzleMechanicsEn: Multi-party trade route allocation puzzle balancing harbor and inland settlement supplies.
11-13.scaffoldingAndHintEn: Ledger notes explain why historical barter differed from modern cash pricing.
11-13.robloxAdapterMechanics: Two-player merchant & boatwright supply chain coordination.
11-13.bedrockAdapterMechanics: Multi-stall barter chain across Al Zubarah courtyard.

14-17.titleEn: Economic History & Methodological Humility in Historical Pricing
14-17.titleAr: التاريخ الاقتصادي ومنهجية توثيق التبادل القديم
14-17.objectiveEn: Evaluate archaeological evidence from Al Zubarah (excavated weights, ceramics, and pearl chests) and explain why historians avoid projecting modern currency values onto 18th-century barter.
14-17.objectiveAr: قيّم الأدلة الأثرية من الزبارة واشرح لماذا يتجنب المؤرخون إسقاط أسعار العملات الحديثة على التبادل التاريخي.
14-17.objectiveArabizi: Qayyim il-adilla il-athariya min Al-Zubarah حول التبادل التجاري القديم.
14-17.puzzleMechanicsEn: Source analysis comparing archaeological weight finds against anachronistic price claims.
14-17.scaffoldingAndHintEn: UNESCO #1402 excavation notes provided in the reference drawer.
14-17.robloxAdapterMechanics: Historical economics simulation with provenance citation checks.
14-17.bedrockAdapterMechanics: Archival ledger audit and fair-trade contract completion.

questActs.settingSubarea: Fictional Doha Heritage Dock Exhibit Pavilion

14-17.titleEn: Heritage Conservation Ethics: Authentic Sites vs Interpretive Exhibits
14-17.titleAr: أخلاقيات الحفاظ العمراني: المواقع الأصيلة مقابل المعارض التعليمية
14-17.objectiveEn: Compare UNESCO earthen-masonry conservation protocols at Al Zubarah with the design of new interpretive museum pavilions so visitors never confuse modern reconstructions with ancient ruins.
14-17.objectiveAr: قارن بين بروتوكولات الحفاظ على العمارة الترابية في الزبارة وتصميم أجنحة العرض الحديثة لعدم الخلط بين الأثر الأصلي والبناء التعليمي.
14-17.objectiveArabizi: Qarin bayn hifz il-athar il-asliya fi Al-Zubarah wa bina il-ma3arid il-ta3limiya.
14-17.scaffoldingAndHintEn: Conservation charter notes explain reversible vs intrusive repairs.
14-17.robloxAdapterMechanics: Architectural conservation planner with interpretive signage placement.

questActs.summaryEn: Gather in the courtyard story circle to explore the Qatari folktale of Al Fisaikra, choose kindness and compassion, and prepare a family-friendly cardamom-saffron hospitality dish (or woven palm craft alternative) with full allergy substitutions.
questActs.summaryAr: اجتمع في حلقة الحكايات للتعرف على الحكاية الشعبية القطرية «الفسيفكرة»، واختر قيم اللطف والرحمة، وحضّر طبق ضيافة عائلي بالهيل والزعفران (أو حرفة سعف النخيل) مع بدائل آمنة للحساسية.
questActs.summaryArabizi: Ijtami3 fi halqat il-hikayat li-sama3 qissat Al-Fisaikra (folklore) wa tahdir tabaq diyafa 3aili amin.
questActs.epistemicWarningEn: Al Fisaikra is labeled explicitly as Qatari/Gulf coastal folklore (pending corroboration of regional variants), never as literal historical fact. Zero compulsory religious elements.

objectiveGraph.descriptionEn: Listen to Ustadha Noora introduce Al Fisaikra as a traditional coastal folktale and choose compassionate responses in the story circle.
objectiveGraph.hintEn: Choose empathy, patience, and fair sharing when the sea-fish guardian asks how to treat neighbors.
objectiveGraph.failureRecovery: Story circle allows re-listening to any scene at your own pace.

objectiveGraph.descriptionEn: Prepare the courtyard hospitality tray (choose standard Saffron-Cardamom Sweet Vermicelli, Gluten-Free/Egg-Free Date-Oat Bites, or Non-Food Khous Palm-Weaving Coaster).
objectiveGraph.hintEn: Select your preferred dietary or craft path at the courtyard table.
objectiveGraph.failureRecovery: All three dietary/craft options award the full quest milestone.

coopBehavior.roleSplitEn: Players take turns choosing kind story responses and arranging hospitality trays around the courtyard carpet.

5-7.titleEn: The Kind Sea-Fish Story & Sweet Tray
5-7.objectiveEn: Help the kind storyteller arrange the shimmering fish storybook and pick safe, yummy treats (or woven coasters) for friends!
5-7.objectiveAr: ساعد الراوية في ترتيب صور حكاية السمكة اللطيفة واختيار ضيافة آمنة أو سلال منسوجة للأصدقاء!
5-7.objectiveArabizi: Sa3id Ustadha Noora fi tartib suwar hikayat Al-Fisaikra wa siniyat il-diyafa!
5-7.puzzleMechanicsEn: 3-scene picture storybook ordering + allergy-safe hospitality tray selection.
5-7.scaffoldingAndHintEn: Heart icons highlight kind choices; allergy-free and craft options are clearly pictured.
5-7.robloxAdapterMechanics: Interactive story cushion circle with picture cards.
5-7.bedrockAdapterMechanics: Story lectern + safe hospitality crafting table.

8-10.titleEn: Folklore vs History in the Story Circle
8-10.titleAr: الحكاية الشعبية والتاريخ في مجلس السمر
8-10.objectiveEn: Explore how Al Fisaikra teaches kindness through coastal folklore, then prepare an allergy-safe Qatari hospitality platter or palm-leaf craft.
8-10.objectiveAr: اكتشف كيف تعلم حكاية الفسيفكرة قيم اللطف، ثم حضّر طبق ضيافة قطري آمن للحساسية أو حرفة خوص.
8-10.objectiveArabizi: Iktishif qيم il-lutf fi hikayat Al-Fisaikra wa haddir siniyat diyafa amina.
8-10.puzzleMechanicsEn: Story choice branching + 3-ingredient recipe/craft assembly with dietary toggle.
8-10.scaffoldingAndHintEn: Badge reminder shows why magical talking fish belong to folklore while harbor tools belong to history.
8-10.robloxAdapterMechanics: Dialogue choice tree + courtyard kitchen/craft station.
8-10.bedrockAdapterMechanics: ActionFormData story choices + custom recipe/craft completion.

11-13.titleEn: Comparative Oral Folklore Across the Gulf Coast
11-13.titleAr: مقارنة الحكايات الشفهية على ساحل الخليج
11-13.objectiveEn: Compare the Qatari tale of Al Fisaikra with marine Cinderella-type folktale motifs across maritime cultures while hosting an inclusive community table.
11-13.objectiveAr: قارن بين حكاية الفسيفكرة القطرية ونظائرها من الحكايات البحرية الشعبية مع تنظيم مائدة مجتمعية شاملة.
11-13.objectiveArabizi: Qarin bayn hikayat Al-Fisaikra wa nazairiha fil-turath il-bahri.
11-13.puzzleMechanicsEn: Folklore motif comparison board + inclusive menu planner.
11-13.scaffoldingAndHintEn: Highlights shared themes (kindness, sea ecology, patience) vs local Gulf coastal details.
11-13.robloxAdapterMechanics: Story motif comparison table + co-op hospitality station.
11-13.bedrockAdapterMechanics: Comparative folklore book puzzle + inclusive feast table setup.

14-17.titleEn: Archiving Intangible Cultural Heritage & Oral Variant Provenance
14-17.titleAr: توثيق التراث الثقافي غير المادي وتعدد الروايات الشفهية
14-17.objectiveEn: Examine how national folklore inventories (such as the Qatar Ministry of Culture catalog) record multiple oral variants without freezing a single "official" text or mistaking folklore for history.
14-17.objectiveAr: ادرس كيف توثق سجلات التراث الوطني الروايات الشفهية المتعددة دون تجميدها في نص واحد أو الخلط بينها وبين التاريخ.
14-17.objectiveArabizi: Idris kayfa tuwaththiq sijillat il-thaqafa il-riwayat il-shafahiya il-muta3addida.
14-17.puzzleMechanicsEn: Archival annotation challenge tagging oral variants, narrator notes, and epistemic status.
14-17.scaffoldingAndHintEn: Links to Qatar Ministry of Culture folklore inventory framework.
14-17.robloxAdapterMechanics: Folklore archive curation desk with variant comparison.

questActs.summaryEn: Learn Qatari and Gulf return-home vocabulary, raise the Al Qaffal shoreline welcome banners, and assemble a non-recorded family story postcard celebrating heritage across distance.
questActs.summaryAr: تعلّم مفردات العودة البحرية، وارفع رايات استقبال القفال على الشاطئ، وصمّم بطاقة حكاية عائلية تحتفي بالتراث عبر المسافات.
questActs.summaryArabizi: Ta3allam kalلمات Al-Qaffal, irfa3 rayat il-istiqbal, wa sammim bitaqat dhikra 3ailiya.
questActs.epistemicWarningEn: Celebrates safe shoreline homecoming and diaspora continuity; never exposes children to perilous diving reenactments or collects personal family data.

objectiveGraph.descriptionEn: Match 6 Qatari maritime & homecoming vocabulary terms across Arabic, Arabizi, and English.
objectiveGraph.hintEn: Review Lulu, Jalboot, Qallaf, Tawash, Al-Fisaikra, and Al-Qaffal in your glossary.

objectiveGraph.descriptionEn: Raise the maroon-and-gold Al Qaffal welcome banners along the pier and complete your Qatar Passport Stamp.
objectiveGraph.hintEn: Coordinate with your co-op partner or Ustadha Noora at the harbor arch.
objectiveGraph.failureRecovery: Harbor arch stays active for replay at any time.

coopBehavior.roleSplitEn: Both players hoist the shoreline welcome pennants together to trigger the Al Qaffal homecoming celebration.

5-7.titleEn: Wave the Welcome Flags for the Boats!
5-7.objectiveEn: Match 3 picture words (Lulu, Jalboot, Al-Qaffal) and wave the maroon welcome flags as the boats sail home!
5-7.objectiveAr: طابق ٣ كلمات مصورة (لؤلؤ، جالبوت، القفال) ولوّح بالرايات العنابية عند عودة السفن!
5-7.objectiveArabizi: Tabiq 3 kalimat (Lulu, Jalboot, Al-Qaffal) wa irfa3 rayat il-terhib!
5-7.scaffoldingAndHintEn: Spoken phonetic prompts guide every word.
5-7.robloxAdapterMechanics: Co-op shoreline banner hoist + confetti celebration.
5-7.bedrockAdapterMechanics: Raise maroon wool/banner blocks + earn Qatar Passport stamp.

8-10.objectiveEn: Complete the 6-word Qatari harbor glossary challenge, arrange the shoreline welcome lanterns, and compose a pre-set cultural postcard.
8-10.objectiveAr: أكمل تحدي مفردات المرفأ الست، ورتب فوانيس الشاطئ، وصمم بطاقة بريدية ثقافية.
8-10.objectiveArabizi: Akmil tahaddi 6 kalimat Qatariya wa rattib fawanis il-seef.
8-10.puzzleMechanicsEn: 6-word bilingual match + pre-set template postcard builder (zero free-text PII).
8-10.scaffoldingAndHintEn: Glossary cards show Arabic script, Arabizi, and English side by side.
8-10.robloxAdapterMechanics: Vocabulary matching board + co-op harbor signal sequence.

11-13.objectiveEn: Coordinate the multi-stage Al Qaffal harbor welcome and curate a bilingual exhibit explaining how Qatari diaspora students connect with coastal heritage.
11-13.objectiveAr: نسّق احتفالية استقبال القفال وصمم معرضاً ثنائي اللغة يشرح كيف يرتبط أبناء المهجر بالتراث الساحلي.
11-13.objectiveArabizi: Nassiq ihtifal Al-Qaffal wa sammim ma3radan thuna'i il-lugha.
11-13.puzzleMechanicsEn: Co-op signal relay + bilingual exhibit captioning challenge.
11-13.scaffoldingAndHintEn: Shows how dialect terms (ar-QA) complement Modern Standard Arabic (ar).
11-13.robloxAdapterMechanics: Two-player synchronized harbor bell & pennant finale.
11-13.bedrockAdapterMechanics: Redstone lamp harbor signal sequence + Passport stamp ceremony.

14-17.titleEn: Transnational Identity, Dialect Register & Cultural Continuity
14-17.titleAr: الهوية العابرة للحدود ومستويات اللغة واستمرارية التراث
14-17.objectiveEn: Synthesize historical, archaeological, and folkloric evidence from Qatar into a complete digital Passport portfolio, distinguishing local Qatari Arabic register from MSA.
14-17.objectiveAr: اجمع الأدلة التاريخية والأثرية والشعبية في ملف جواز سفر رقمي متكامل مع التمييز بين اللهجة القطرية والفصحى.
14-17.objectiveArabizi: Ijma3 il-adilla il-tarikhiya wal-athariya wal-sha3biya fi milaff Jawaz il-Safar.
14-17.puzzleMechanicsEn: Capstone synthesis challenge verifying epistemic labels, dialect register, and provenance citations.
14-17.scaffoldingAndHintEn: Full source registry and UNESCO/MoC references accessible.
14-17.robloxAdapterMechanics: Capstone curator presentation & co-op harbor finale.
14-17.bedrockAdapterMechanics: Master archivist verification & Qatar Passport stamp completion.

familyConversationPrompts.questionEn: Ask an elder or parent: What is a favorite family celebration or welcome ritual when relatives return from a long journey?
familyConversationPrompts.questionAr: اسأل أحد الوالدين أو الأجداد: ما هي أجمل عادة عائلية لاستقبال المسافرين عند عودتهم إلى البيت؟
familyConversationPrompts.questionArabizi: Is'al ahlak: Shinu ajmal 3ada 3ailiya li-istiqbal il-musafirin?
familyConversationPrompts.privacyNoteEn: Optional offline family conversation—never recorded, uploaded, or required to finish any quest.

familyConversationPrompts.questionEn: Ask at home: Do we have a favorite spice—like cardamom, saffron, or cinnamon—that reminds our family of home?
familyConversationPrompts.questionAr: اسأل في البيت: هل لدينا بهار مفضل مثل الهيل أو الزعفران يذكّر عائلتنا بالوطن؟
familyConversationPrompts.questionArabizi: Is'al fil-bayt: Hal 3indana bahar mufaddal mithl il-heel aw il-za3faran?
familyConversationPrompts.privacyNoteEn: Optional offline conversation prompt; MiraVerse never collects family names, voice, or migration history.

traditionsAndFood.dishOrCraftNameEn: Saffron-Cardamom Hospitality Tray (Balaleet-Inspired Sweet Vermicelli) & Khous Palm Weaving
traditionsAndFood.dishOrCraftNameAr: صينية الضيافة بالهيل والزعفران وحرفة سف الخوص
traditionsAndFood.dishOrCraftNameArabizi: Siniyat il-Diyafa bil-Heel wal-Za3faran wa Saff il-Khous
traditionsAndFood.descriptionEn: Warm cardamom-and-saffron scented hospitality served during storytelling gatherings, paired with traditional date-palm frond weaving (saff al-khous).
allergySafeSubstitutionsEn: Gluten-free rice vermicelli or date-cardamom oat bites instead of wheat vermicelli
Egg-free sweet saffron-rosewater fruit compote option
Nut-free and sesame-free preparation by default
traditionsAndFood.nonFoodCraftAlternativeEn: Weave a geometric Qatari khous (date-palm frond) table mat using color-coded paper or fiber strips.

architecturalFeaturesEn: Coral-stone and limestone courtyard walls coated with insulating juss (gypsum plaster)
Danshal mangrove timber ceiling beams imported via historic Indian Ocean trade
Shaded liwan arcades and carved wooden doors with geometric floral rosettes
architectureAndMusic.rhythmicTraditionNoteEn: Original licensed rhythmic sea-return percussion inspired by Gulf maritime work cadences—never reproducing copyrighted recordings or sacred ceremonies.
